components.title: Deduplicate and count orders per customer
components.what: Remove exact duplicate order rows (same order_id and all fields), then tally distinct orders per customer_id regardless of status.

components.title: Identify max and map name
components.what: Find the customer_id with the highest order count and map it to their name from the Customers table.

components.title: Format final answer
components.what: Output the customer name only, preceded by the exact line 'FINAL: <name>'.
